config.prompt: Generate a factual, objective alt-text description for a visually impaired user. Avoid redundancy and speculation.

anchors_prior_runs.MiMo-VL-7B-RL (~8B, projected): ~13-14 min/image, ~16 GB -> OOM-risk on A1, GPU-only

verdict: Sub-7B modern Qwen VLMs fit A1 RAM (8-10 GB) and deliver best-tier alt-text quality, but at ~6-7 min/image on CPU -> async-worker only (>> 20 s interactive bar). 7B (MiMo-VL / Phi-4) is GPU-only on memory grounds. Qwen3-VL-4B = best quality; Qwen2.5-VL-3B = leaner/faster at near-equal quality. Presented for testing; no adapter implemented.
